payloads.players: docs/campus/data/<L>/<season>/players.json -> players{pid}.values / pct / pct_pos (cfb: rates in pct_pos only) / role + pct_role (mbb, wbb) / qualified / qualified_rate (cfb)

notes: Percentiles compare within all FBS (cfb) or all Division I (mbb, wbb) by group and season, not within conference tier: raw rates of players at weaker conferences are inflated by easier opponents (transfers from outside the power conferences to a power conference lose 0.3-0.9 SD on volume rates and 0.1-0.4 SD on efficiency), but the tier gap inside a season is small for most player rates (0.0-0.3 SD) and pooling keeps the samples large. Show the player's conference tier beside the card and offer a Power / rest filter. The basketball box rating r is already team- and schedule-adjusted (transfers up: change near 0 SD), which is why it leads the card.
Power conferences: cfb SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC, Pac-12 to 2023, Big East to 2012, Notre Dame (football.data.is_power); basketball ACC, Big East, Big Ten, Big 12, SEC, Pac-12 to the 2024 season.
Transfers: season t -> t+1 pairs include players who changed team (cfb 7-29% of pairs by group, basketball 9-15%); yoy_r_transfers in each metric's reliability block.
New fields (payload_status 'added') are in the builders from 22 Oct 2026 and reach the published payloads at the next build.
